claim: The pipeline processes the current Cassini ISS NAC/H-alpha Jupiter image set.
safe_wording: The current reproducible run processes 221 Cassini ISS NAC/H-alpha frames.
unsafe_wording: The pipeline processes every relevant Cassini Jupiter image.
remaining_work: Expand OPUS coverage only with documented query criteria and regenerated manifests.

claim: The detector recovers the published lightning validation marks.
safe_wording: The detector recovers 6 of 6 published validation marks within the configured matching radius.
unsafe_wording: The detector proves all lightning has been found.
remaining_work: Keep threshold changes tied to known-match recall and report any missed validation mark.

claim: The detector generates a review queue rather than a confirmed discovery catalog.
safe_wording: The workflow curates 12611 review candidates and a 106-row first-pass review plan.
unsafe_wording: The detector found thousands of lightning events.
remaining_work: Complete human review sessions and preserve false positives for analysis.

claim: Human labels are not yet sufficient for training or scientific discovery claims.
unsafe_wording: The model has been trained on reviewed labels.
remaining_work: Review S001 for known positives and S005-S006 for negative examples, then import labels.

claim: Candidate-level Jupiter latitude/longitude is not ready yet.
unsafe_wording: The detector already maps each candidate to a Jovian storm location.
remaining_work: Acquire/document NAIF Cassini SPICE kernels and ISS camera model assumptions before location claims.

claim: Nearby filter context is a follow-up queue, not a color/spectrum result.
safe_wording: The workflow has 769 nearby non-HAL context rows for follow-up review after candidate validation.
unsafe_wording: The project measured the color spectrum of new lightning events.
remaining_work: Use nearby-filter products only after candidates survive human, temporal, and geometry review.

claim: YOLO or learned-model comparison is not ready until reviewed labels exist.
unsafe_wording: YOLO has been trained and outperforms the classical detector.
remaining_work: Create at least 6 positive and 20 negative high-confidence reviewed labels with notes.

claim: No new Jovian lightning discovery is confirmed by the current output alone.
safe_wording: Unmatched candidates are review targets until human, temporal, and geometry checks support a stronger claim.
remaining_work: Manually review and validate candidates before moving any unmatched row into a discovery table.
